end.summary:
Recognised halves, thirds and quarters as equal parts in shapes and sharing examples.
Named shaded fractions such as one-third after checking total parts.
Compared 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 correctly; explained that more equal shares make smaller pieces.
Practised finding a fraction of a collection by grouping; did not yet complete the method independently.
Teach-back was not passed; no misconceptions were recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, naming fractions, comparing unit fractions, and finding a fraction of a collection. Nisha used the equal-parts idea well and corrected their thinking about total parts and shaded parts during the lesson. They were still unsure about the “of” method for collections, so at home, share 6 or 12 small objects into 2, 3, or 4 equal groups and name one group as the fraction.
